(2) Persistent vs event distinction: siren_ringing is a condition, but (u0, siren_ringing) -> u1 fires on the condition's step while the actual silencing requires (u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u7; however from u1 there is no self-loop for further rings starting again while in u1 handling is fine, but if the agent toggles the switch while the siren is silent (a no-op toggle, explicitly possible per the semantics) the guard (u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) would reward 0.5 for doing nothing useful from u0's perspective — actually from u0 the siren is not ringing, so u1 is only entered when ringing; but the same guard from u7 (u7, else) -> u7 silently absorbs switch toggles that do not silence a ringing siren, with no regression or negative signal, so repeated spurious toggles are indistinguishable from correct behavior and progress rewards for the ring-handling clause are neither dense nor correctly bounded per ring instance. (3) Reachability of FINAL_STATES: u8 is declared and reachable only via the flawed food_fall path; if the task clause 'if the food falls, pick it up on the very next move' never triggers in an episode, no terminal state is reached, yet the task's other clauses (siren off, serve clients) are fully satisfiable and should themselves reach accepting states — a single accepting state gated behind an optional event makes the RM's accepting set wrong for the task. (4) Ordered transition coverage: the chain order client_arrived -> order_taken -> food_prepared -> order_served is represented, but from u2 the transition (u2, else) -> u2 permits staying in u2 forever (client waits unbounded) with no negative or bounded dense shaping, so the environment's -0.5 late-ringing penalty while a client waits is not mirrored even softly; the RM gives no signal distinguishing a waiting client under a ringing siren (served_while_ringing is available as a predicate and unused). (5) Predicate-only events and else self-loops: else self-loops exist per state, good, but the conjunction guards (e.g. switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) mix an event with a condition whose truth is evaluated on the same step; per the semantics switch_toggled is an event and siren_ringing a condition read after the step, which is consistent, but the guard (u0, switch_toggled & siren_ringing) is contradictory or at least ambiguous: a toggle that silences the siren leaves siren_ringing false after the step, so this transition can only fire on a toggle during a ring that does not stop it — which cannot happen per the environment (the siren stops only on switch toggle and any switch toggle stops it). feedback: Missing FINAL_STATES is not the issue (u6 is declared and accepting), but the machine has several fatal flaws. (1) No self-loop on u6 with non-zero event coverage is fine for liveness, but the task is open-ended with no goal: state u6 must be accepting but the machine wrongly treats serving the first client as terminal completion of the whole task. (2) Order-of-events loss: after food_prepared from u3 the machine jumps to u0/u2, dropping the pending 'serve the client' obligation — order_served then only yields reward if a client_arrived intervened (u5), so a served order after prepare is untracked (order_served from u0/u2 is never rewarded and never transitions to u6). This breaks the client-task chain for every client after the first: u2→u3→food_prepared→u0 loses that the client is waiting to be served. (3) The 'pick up food on the very next move' clause is not captured: u4→u5 on holding_food at any later step, not the next step, and food_fell while holding nothing (dropped food) or food_fell followed by siren/client interleavings pass through u0, resetting the obligation — regression/ordered tracking for the slip rule is absent. (4) Bounded dense rewards are okay in magnitude (0.05–1.0), but the food_fell reward of 0.05 pays for the slip itself, rewarding the event the agent should prevent/react to, an unsafe shaping choice; and u0 food_fell→u4 is unreachable from u2/u3 slip when combined with other events (e.g., food_fell & siren_ringing in u0 falls to else→u0, losing both). (5) u5 'else'→u0 means after picking up food, a siren start is handled but the serve obligation from u5 only survives until any client_arrived or else event; the else self-loop to u0 erases the holding-food state without serve, so the food-fall rule can be 'completed' by any event. (6) Reachability: u6 reachable only via u5 order_served; serving from u0/u2 (e.g., serve with siren silent after food_prepared reset) gives reward 1.0 nowhere — order_served from u0/u2/u3 transitions to nothing (u3 order_served→u0 is stated in transitions but no reward) and misses the +1. Fix: keep a per-client chain state (arrived→ordered→prepared→served→back to idle), track a dedicated slip state requiring pickup on the immediately following step, make order_served rewarding and state-changing from the prepared state, and cover food_fell&other-event conjunctions.
